scope: Local text spam classification and reversible message visibility
implemented: Decrypted text is inspected locally for URL user-info destination disguise, repeated-link bursts and mass mentions with multiple links.
All/nonfriends/off modes and self-message exemption control shared channel/DM message visibility.
Flagged content, link previews, attachments and reaction rows are hidden with localized reasons and explicit restore. The underlying message is not deleted or modified.

Restore uses validated account preferences containing only message IDs and revision timestamps, never plaintext or content hashes. Edited messages are rechecked; unavailable plaintext remains unknown.
A bounded 1024-entry restore map uses existing preference persistence/retry infrastructure. Beyond that bound, reveal remains session-local; dedicated spam decision storage is still needed.
Incoming channel and DM spam skips TTS, desktop toast, notification sound and normal unread cue generation after retaining the message in its owning store.

verification.command: full client vitest run before final incoming-cue integration
vitest run dmEventHandlers channelNavigation spamClassification after incoming-cue integration

remaining: Persistent spam inbox, restore/delete/report actions and cross-device synchronization.
Server-side policy enforcement for supported metadata and plaintext flows.
Search, quote, group-DM and sidebar preview filtering; focused integration tests for blocked spam attention cues.
Classifier evaluation against representative labeled samples and real-client acceptance.
acceptance: Partial foundation only; p3.spam and p3.classifier remain missing.
